description: This file defines the Clock class providing methods to manipulate and simulate system time within a browser context, including methods to install, fast-forward, pause, resume, run for a duration, and set fixed or system time. It also includes helper functions to parse time and tick inputs.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: Provides methods to control and manipulate system time within a browser context, implementing the api.Clock interface.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the clock with an optional time, parsing input time if provided.

methods.name: fastForward
methods.description: Fast-forwards the clock by a specified number of ticks or a string representation.

methods.name: pauseAt
methods.description: Pauses the clock at a specific time.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the clock if it was paused.

methods.name: runFor
methods.description: Runs the clock forward by the specified number of ticks or string.

methods.name: setFixedTime
methods.description: Sets the clock to a fixed specific time.

methods.name: function parseTicks(ticks: string | number): { ticksNumber?: number, ticksString?: string } { parseTicks
function parseTime(time: string | number | Date): { timeNumber?: number, timeString?: string } { parseTime

ctags.name: parseTicks
ctags.pattern: /^function parseTicks(ticks: string | number): { ticksNumber?: number, ticksString?: string } {$/

ctags.name: parseTime
ctags.pattern: /^function parseTime(time: string | number | Date): { timeNumber?: number, timeString?: string } {$/
